name: Depths of Moria
game_text:
To play, spot a <culture>Moria</culture> Orc.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, add <twilight>2</twilight>.
flavor_text: “...a great fissure had opened. Out of it a fierce red light came, and now and again flames licked at the brink.... Wisps of dark smoke wavered in the hot air.”
